The pod's memory metrics are absent in abnormal, so the pre-restart trend cannot be measured directly; this is inferred from the abrupt timing.

A heap squeeze would climb toward its limit and then restart the process. The abrupt ready-to-crash transition in ten seconds shows no heap ramp. Heap metrics are absent in abnormal, so this is inferred from timing, not measured.

An unhandled exception in profile would leave its pod emitting spans and logs, with error status on the Server side. Profile emits no spans or logs in abnormal, and the pod's metric set collapses to three names, which is a pod-level gap rather than an in-process throw.
